actions.firmwareEvidence: Cheat data is pinned to the exact native PS5 game build. The curator does not certify a firmware range or this site’s hardware execution.
actions.license: No repository-wide licence is declared by this community collection. Original cheat-creator credit is retained; no official etaHEN authorship is implied.
actions.metadataValidation: Exact curator filename and independently listed game title identify this encrypted MC4 build. Bytes were not decoded, modified or executed.
requirements: Native PS5 GTA V, title ID PPSA04263, exact game version 01.010.002. Do not use this file for the PS4 edition or another game update.
A homebrew-enabled PS5 with etaHEN or another cheat manager that supports MC4. This file is cheat data, not a standalone ELF/BIN payload or a full mod menu.
Keep a backup of any existing file. Copy this ready file as PPSA04263_01.010.002.mc4 to /data/etaHEN/cheats/mc4/ using FTP or your console file manager.
Open the matching game, then etaHEN Toolbox > Cheats. Choose and toggle individual cheats through the manager; downloading the file does not enable anything.
The official etaHEN repository documents JSON, SHN and MC4 formats and one format per title/version. Avoid keeping conflicting cheat variants for the same game build.
Community-curated definitions were checked for their source identity and exact filename/build metadata. They were not hardware-tested or executed during this import.
actions.installation: The upstream creator-suffix filename is retained in provenance. Download bytes are unchanged; the served filename uses etaHEN’s documented TITLEID_version.format convention.
